FOrcaSlicer 2.3.2-fos.8.6.4

New: you can now choose which nozzles print support and the prime tower wall. Support/raft base, Support/raft interface and Wipe tower wall each have a Custom option; choosing it enables a nozzle list underneath where you tick the nozzles that job may use. All nozzles in one selection must share a diameter, so ticking one greys out the others. A nozzle you choose is used for that job on every layer, first layer included, and the prime tower is printed with a chosen nozzle even if nothing else on the plate uses it. The Wipe tower setting is now called Wipe tower wall.

Fixed: with Desynced on, changing a nozzle's diameter updated the filament list but left that nozzle's process preset on the old diameter until a printer preset was saved. Every nozzle, including Nozzle 1, now re-picks a matching process preset as soon as its diameter changes, and a previously saved per-nozzle choice no longer overrides the diameter.

Chinese: 20 new strings covering the nozzle selection controls and the slicing messages that go with them.
